pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa pūgassa pariveṇavāsikā bhikkhuniyo yāguyā kilamanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.3: atha kho so pūgo bhikkhunīnaṃ yāgu atthāya chandakaṃ saṃharitvā aññatarassa āpaṇikassa ghare parikkhāraṃ nikkhipitvā bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.4: “amukassa ayye āpaṇikassa ghare yāgu atthāya parikkhāro nikkhitto tato taṇḍulaṃ āharāpetvā yāguṃ pacāpetvā paribhuñjathā”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.5: bhikkhuniyo tena parikkhārena bhesajjaṃ cetāpetvā paribhuñjiṃsu. atha kho
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.6: so pūgo jānitvā ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpessantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpessanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.14.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.10: yaṃ atthāya dinnaṃ, taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ cetāpeti payoge dukkaṭaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.12: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.15: idaṃ me ayye aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajāmīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.19.1: aññadatthike aññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.20: aññadatthike vematikā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.21: aññadatthike anaññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
